name: Moonglow Vest
summary: In Darnassus, Lotherias prepares leather gear for young adventurers setting out across Kalimdor. She offers a night elf pattern in return for shipments of embossed leather goods.

sections.title: Equipping the Kaldorei
sections.body: Darnassus leatherworkers outfit sentinels and young scouts. Night elves and allied wanderers leave Teldrassil for Kalimdor's wilds, where sturdy armor is in demand. Lotherias is a master leatherworker who supplies them with gear.

sections.title: Mastering the Craft
sections.body: Lotherias asks apprentices to bring matching embossed gloves, boots, and cloaks to show their skill. Those who fulfill her order earn her trust. She teaches them a night elf pattern for a vest that protects while allowing free movement.

faq.answer: Lotherias is a night elf leatherworking trainer in Darnassus. She teaches the craft and shares advanced patterns with leatherworkers who prove their skill.

faq.q: Why does Lotherias need so many leather items?
faq.answer: Lotherias needs embossed leather gear for young adventurers preparing to travel beyond Darnassus. She asks apprentices to supply the standard garments.
The Moonglow Vest is a leather armor pattern Lotherias teaches after you prove you can craft embossed goods in quantity.

faq.q: What materials are required to complete this task?
faq.answer: Bring Lotherias one pair of Embossed Leather Gloves, five pairs of Embossed Leather Boots, and five Embossed Leather Cloaks. Craft each piece and deliver it to her.

faq.q: Can Horde leatherworkers learn this pattern here?
faq.answer: No. Lotherias trains Alliance craftspeople in Darnassus. Horde leatherworkers need trainers of their own across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Does this quest require a specific trade skill level?
aliases: when can i get moonglow vest
faq.answer: Yes. You need leatherworking proficiency of at least seventy before Lotherias considers you skilled enough for her order and the vest pattern.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see Teldrassil's fine leatherwork in the Moonglow Vest. It gives scouts and sentinels agile protection beneath the forest canopy.
As an Alliance artisan, you help outfit new recruits in Darnassus. The Alliance holds a fragile foothold in northern Kalimdor amid growing wild and hostile threats.
